correctness.rationale: The assigned verifier independently reconstructs CxC, dual H_1 bases, and exhaustively enumerates all monotone self-maps, obtaining 8042896 maps, 25 matrices, 32 rank-two maps and the eight signed permutation matrices. Independently of that computation, the already-published exact classification of maps T->C gives 2836 coordinate maps and exactly five possible row vectors; squaring gives 2836^2=8042896 and exactly 25 matrices. Invertibility forces the two distinct signed coordinate rows, so only signed permutations occur and the shear is impossible. The four representatives per invertible matrix give 32 maps, and these product projection/automorphism pairs are homeomorphisms.
